packages.qualification: Splunkbase app 7719 listing was checked on 2026-10-26; 0.9.0 is the current default and matches the supplied archive. Static package/docs analysis only. No live ThousandEyes account or Splunk HEC readback. Confirm OTel account ID to API aid mapping, flattened HEC field paths, event/path source and host metadata, and producer timestamps with sanitized readback before typed normalization. Cisco's OTel detailed trace schema and general v2/Splunk input pages disagree on API trace support; require a sample or Cisco confirmation. The packaged CEA path pull omits request-scoped aid/testId from result events, so typed CEA path admission requires an external adapter to attach those exact configured request identities (or a received payload that already contains them).
